title: fix(cloud-connection): an install-local uninstall withdraws the metadata-service copies of its objects, so the meta object reads drop them at once
body:
Fixes #24070

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` now takes the package's objects out of `GET /api/v1/meta/object` and `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` at once, as its data route, `meta/app` and `meta/permission` already did. A restart is no longer needed.

- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`: new `withdrawObjectCopies`. The DELETE handler runs it right after `withdrawFromRunningKernel` has withdrawn the registry half, before the uninstall cleanups, and only when the registry withdrew. It removes, through the existing `IMetadataService.unregister('object', name, { notify: false })`, each object copy in the `metadata` service whose `_packageId` is this package's id and whose name the registry no longer serves.
  - A copy the service refuses to remove is reported on the answer as one failed `cleanups` entry named `metadata.unregister`, the same shape as the refused `registry.uninstallPackage` entry. The `note` says so, the operator `warn` names the objects kept and the remedy, and the cause stays off the wire.
  - When nothing is refused, the answer is byte-for-byte what it was.
  - Docblocks updated: the file header's DELETE paragraph and `withdrawFromRunningKernel`. A new constant `OBJECT_COPY_WITHDRAWAL` sits beside `REGISTRY_WITHDRAWAL`.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-uninstall-meta-reads.test.ts` (new pin, beside the existing install-local DELETE pins).
- `.changeset/24070-withdraw-meta-object-copies.md` (`patch`).

## The mechanism, measured

- **H1, confirmed with one correction.** The two object reads consult the `metadata` service besides the `SchemaRegistry`:
  - `getMetaItems` merges `metadataService.list(type)` into its answer (`readFlattenedMetaItems`, the "Merge with MetadataService" block);
  - `getMetaItem` reads the service BEFORE the registry (step 2, `readItemFromMetadataService`).
  - The copies there are not the protocol's: they are produced by ObjectQL's `manifest.register`. On a started kernel it calls `bridgeManifestObjectsToMetadataService` (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`), which registers each of the package's objects into the service stamped `_packageId`. The install door's own comment says so ("register also bridges the manifest's objects into the metadata service").
  - `SchemaRegistry.uninstallPackage` clears only the registry. `meta/app` and `meta/permission` cleared because the bridge copies `object` only.
- **H2, falsified.** The protocol door's withdrawal does not apply here, for two reasons:
  - `DELETE /packages/:id` → `deletePackage` withdraws per stored `sys_metadata` row (`deleteMetaItem`), then `registry.uninstallPackage`. For a runtime-authored object, ObjectQL's `followRuntimeObjectCopy` then removes the service copy on that row's mutation. Nothing there withdraws a bridged code-package copy.
  - That door refuses an install-local package before reaching any of it: an installed app is read-only, so `requireWritablePackage` answers `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`). The two doors serve disjoint populations.
  - The existing API used instead is `IMetadataService.unregister` with `notify: false`, the same call and the same two conditions ObjectQL's own copy-follow takes before it removes a copy.
  - QA's own item 2 (the protocol door, `qag13_probe`) was not re-measured.
- **H3.** Single kernel, confirmed: the in-process pin and the live probe below each run one kernel. The cloud repository's second-kernel card was not read from this session: NOT MEASURED.

**Landing point.** The copy's producer is ObjectQL's bridge. The fix still lands at the install-local door, which is the caller whose `manifest.register` produced the copy and the only door that withdraws such a package. It uses an existing service verb and touches neither `packages/objectql` nor `packages/metadata-protocol` nor `packages/spec`.

## Tests (HEAD `8316228a9`)

The pin uses a real `ObjectKernel` with `ObjectQLPlugin`: the real engine, `manifest` service, metadata protocol and the kernel's in-memory `metadata` service. A driver holding no row serves the stored-row layer. Four cases:

1. hot install → DELETE;
2. ledger rehydrate → DELETE;
3. CONTROL: a same-name copy without the package's stamp stays;
4. a refused `unregister` gives one failed `metadata.unregister` outcome, and the cleanups still run.

After each DELETE, cases 1 and 2 read `meta/object` (list), `meta/object/NAME`, `meta/app` and `meta/permission`.

| run | result |
|:--|:--|
| before: plugin source reverted in the tree to the base blob `99154e8a` (proved by `git hash-object`), test at `8316228a9` | **4 failed / 4**: after the DELETE `meta/object` still lists both objects and the by-name read serves both; `meta/app` and `meta/permission` already empty; no outcome on the refused case |
| restore | `git checkout HEAD -- …`, on-disk blob equals the HEAD blob `f7f13c18`, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` clean |
| after: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `8316228a9` | **50 files / 602 tests passed** |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck` (both programs) | exit 0; `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` contains the new test file (count 1) |
| `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the two changed `.ts` files | exit 0 |

The subject is imported by relative path (`./marketplace-install-local-plugin.js`, `src`), so the before leg needed no rebuild.

## The public door, before and after (live `os start`)

Setup: `os start` from this worktree's CLI (`OS_CLOUD_URL=off`, real `MetadataPlugin`), signed in as the dev admin. Package A (`com.example.crmlite`: two objects, an app, a permission set) and package B (`com.example.crmliteext`: one `objectExtensions` field on A's `crmlite_account`) are installed inline through install-local, then B and A are DELETEd.

- **Before:** `cloud-connection` source at the base, rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0. After `DELETE …/com.example.crmlite` answered 200:
  - `GET /meta/object` still listed `crmlite_account(com.example.crmlite)` and `crmlite_contact(com.example.crmlite)`;
  - `GET /meta/object/crmlite_account` and `GET /meta/object/crmlite_contact` answered 200;
  - `meta/app` and `meta/permission` were empty, and `GET /data/crmlite_account` answered 404. This is the card's reading.
- **After** (HEAD's source rebuilt, preflight marker present, exit 0), the same sequence:
  - `GET /meta/object` lists none of them;
  - both by-name reads answer `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`;
  - `meta/app` and `meta/permission` are empty, data answers 404, and `cleanups` is `[security.package-permissions: success]` only.
- The probe script and its server lived outside the repository, and the server was stopped by its recorded process group.

## Gates (after the final commit, `8316228a9`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 64 commands. All 64 were run with the exit code captured before any pipe.
- 62 exited 0 on the first pass. Two exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), then 0:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` could not read its pinned positive-control commit in the shallow clone. The object was present on the retry, which exited 0 (48 cases).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed built output of 10 packages outside the CLI closure. After the full `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` it exited 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.
- Not run locally and declared to CI: `test:repo`, the CLI `integration` tier (this diff touches no spawn entry), the `Type Check` lanes beyond this package's own `typecheck`, the dogfood shards and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Boundary, measured at the live door on both builds; not fixed here.** A package that EXTENDS another package's object leaves its field in the by-name read after its own DELETE.
  - Reading: after `DELETE …/com.example.crmliteext`, `GET /meta/object/crmlite_account` still answers 200 with `ext_score`, until a restart. `GET /meta/object` and the data plane no longer carry the field.
  - Cause: B's bridge rewrote the OWNER's copy (stamped with A's id) with the merged body, and nothing restores it when B is withdrawn. The withdrawal here deliberately never touches a copy stamped with another package.
  - A fix needs the names B contributed to and a rewrite of A's copy from the registry's current definition. That rewrite is the bridge's operation, so it belongs with the bridge in `packages/objectql`, outside this card. It is reported to the seat to file.
- **Read-only inference, not measured.** If, after the withdrawal, the registry still serves a name the package owned (for example, a tenant overlay re-promoted to owner), the package's stamped copy of that name is left in place. This follows ObjectQL's own copy-follow rule: never remove a copy of a name the registry still serves.
- The pin reads through the protocol methods the `meta` routes call, in process, with the kernel's in-memory `metadata` service, because `cloud-connection` does not depend on `@objectstack/metadata`. The `MetadataPlugin` path is the live probe above.
